explanation: Each platform credits every order its own ads touched, so an order whose customer clicked both a search ad and a social ad is claimed twice: 900 + 700 = 1,600 against 1,200 real orders. On Voltmarkt's own orders the CPA is 48,000 / 1,200 = 40.00 euros. Returning customers' orders do count in CPA; leaving them out would give a CAC.
